free_tier.stated: A free account includes 300 testing minutes on real iOS and Android devices with no credit card required; the Startup plan starts at $83/month and includes 500 minutes a month.
free_tier.notes: The $83/month Startup plan buys 500 testing minutes, which is $9.96 an hour at the included-minute rate. Accelerate starts at $399/month for 3,000 minutes a month.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a real-device testing session, not an object

retention.stated: unverified: the pricing and signup pages read do not state how long screenshots, videos and network logs are kept

egress.terms: not published: the pages read state no egress allowance or price for traffic from the hosted devices

interface_detail: Manual testing in the browser and scripted automation with Appium, Selenium, Espresso and XCUITest on the public cloud; the signup page promises AI-generated Appium scripts.
endpoint: unverified: no API endpoint is stated on the pages read
tooling: A user drives the public cloud from the browser or submits Appium, Selenium, Espresso or XCUITest scripts; the Enterprise tier also offers hosted private device slots and on-premises devices.
chaining: A mobile test suite can run against public real devices and collect screenshots, videos and network logs without the user owning the devices.

limits.value: 300 testing minutes on the free account; 500 minutes a month on Startup

limits_note: Public cloud access is included on Startup, Accelerate and Scale; hosted private device slots have a 5-device minimum on higher plans. Enterprise pricing is by request.
binding_note: The 300 free testing minutes, then the 500 a month on the cheapest paid plan, bind first for a single user.

identity_cost.detail: The free-account page offers Google, GitHub or email signup, asks for a work email and states no credit card is required; no phone or ID document is requested on that page.

reliability_note: unverified: the pages read state no ban, throttle or data-loss behaviour for the free account
confidence_note: Price and included minutes are quoted from Kobiton's own pricing and free-account pages read on 2026-11-25; retention and reliability pages were not available.
